lines.text: Many learners say: I eat medicine every morning.
Better: I take medicine every morning.
We take medicine, we do not eat it.
Take! Don't forget to take your medicine.

data.why: We take medicine, we do not eat it.

native.tip: ไทยพูด “กินยา” แต่อังกฤษใช้ take กับยา: “I take medicine”

en.tip: Thai “eats” medicine, but English uses take: “I take medicine”
en.caption: Do you say “I eat medicine every morning”? 😅 Thai says “eat” for medicine, but English uses take. Say “I take medicine every morning”! Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
